_note: Task families. Eval families are held out of training entirely so the hack readout is on unseen task types.
train: string manipulation (case, reversal, counting characters, palindromes, anagrams)
list processing (filtering, deduplication, chunking, running totals, rotations)
integer arithmetic and number theory (digits, divisors, gcd, primes, base conversion)
dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
simple text formatting (padding, wrapping, title-casing, abbreviations, slugs)
date and time arithmetic without external libraries (day-of-week, leap years, durations in minutes)
basic validation (emails by simple rules, passwords, ISBN checksums, brackets balanced)
sorting and ranking (custom keys, stable ordering, top-k, medians)
eval: 2D grid and matrix operations (transpose, neighbours, path counts, flood fill sizes)
parsing small structured strings (key=value lists, simple CSV rows, version strings, time ranges)
geometry and coordinates (distances, rectangle overlap, point in polygon for rectangles/triangles)
simple simulations and state machines (bank balances over transactions, elevator stops, traffic lights)
